description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. 00-page-0.json holds page 0 for blocks 0 to 99 with one event whose object holds the key method twice, first EscrowOpened and then EscrowReleased. JSON.parse keeps the last copy and other parsers keep the first, so the event has no one meaning, and a page file with a key repeated in one object cannot be read (clause 12): the whole census refuses. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
